convertibility_reason: Uses iCustom for a custom indicator (CoeffofLine_true) and includes external .mqh library (TradeAlgorithms.mqh) for trade execution logic, requiring manual recreation of both the custom indicator logic and trading algorithms in Python.

derived_values.name: min_rates_total - minimum bars required for calculation

other_exits: Long position closed when indicator value on SignalBar goes negative (Value[1]<0)
Short position closed when indicator value on SignalBar goes positive (Value[1]>0)

position_sizing.conditional_logic: negative MM value = fixed lot size (abs value), positive MM value = deposit share fraction for risk-based sizing

custom_logic_notes: The CoeffofLine_true indicator is a zero-line oscillator. Entry signals use a 2-bar lookback: previous bar (Value[1], offset SignalBar+1) must be on one side of zero and current reference bar (Value[0], offset SignalBar) must have crossed to the opposite side, confirming a crossover. SignalBar=1 means the EA reads from bar 1 (last closed) and bar 2 for crossover detection, avoiding repainting. The BuyPosOpen/SellPosOpen and BuyPosClose/SellPosClose boolean inputs act as independent gate switches for each direction and action. UpSignalTime/DnSignalTime are set to the current bar's opening time (last bar date + period seconds) and passed to the trade execution functions, likely used for trade signature/identification rather than pending order timing.
python_conversion_notes: The CoeffofLine_true custom indicator must be reverse-engineered or sourced separately - it appears to be a coefficient of linear regression line indicator using SMMA smoothing. The TradeAlgorithms.mqh library handles BuyPositionOpen, SellPositionOpen, BuyPositionClose, SellPositionClose, CIsNewBar, LoadHistory, and GlobalVariableDel_ - all must be reimplemented in Python. The conditional MM sizing (negative=fixed lots, positive=deposit fraction) needs careful handling. The crossover detection reads 2 consecutive values from the indicator buffer at SignalBar offset - ensure bar indexing matches MT5's series convention. SL/TP are in points (not pips) so no 5-digit adjustment is needed as they are already point-based, but verify broker point size.
